status.beyondsolo.title: TITLE
status.beyondsolo.unevaluated.desc: The System cannot read you yet. Find a village and touch the crystal in its Evaluation Zone.
stat.beyondsolo.str.desc: Strength. More melee damage, harder crits and less knockback.
stat.beyondsolo.agi.desc: Agility. Faster movement and attacks, dodge chance, quicker bow draw, and longer, faster-recharging combat rolls (an extra roll every 25 points).
stat.beyondsolo.vit.desc: Vitality. More max health, natural armor and toughness, better healing, faster fatigue recovery, and resistance to every element and to exhaustion.
stat.beyondsolo.int.desc: Intelligence. More max mana, faster mana regen, shorter cooldowns, and stronger elemental hits (more buildup).
stat.beyondsolo.sense.desc: Sense. Crit chance, luck and reach.
objective.beyondsolo.find_village.desc: You woke up somewhere unknown. Find a village to learn what happened to you.
objective.beyondsolo.find_evaluation_zon: Find the Evaluation Zone in this village and touch the crystal to receive your rank and class.
log.beyondsolo.hint: hides the pop-ups on screen, or brings the latest back
hud.beyondsolo.collapsed.hint: Your body won't move. Sleep or wait it out.
evaluation.beyondsolo.scan.title: EVALUATING
evaluation.beyondsolo.rank.title: %s-Rank
evaluation.beyondsolo.rank.e: Faint mana response. Everyone starts somewhere.
evaluation.beyondsolo.rank.d: Stable mana response. A spark worth feeding.
evaluation.beyondsolo.rank.c: Strong mana response. Solid potential confirmed.
evaluation.beyondsolo.class.warrior: Strength and endurance. First into every fight.
evaluation.beyondsolo.class.assassin: Speed and precision. Strikes before the enemy can react.
evaluation.beyondsolo.class.mage: Vast mana and a sharp mind. Power from a distance.
evaluation.beyondsolo.class.guardian: Unshakable vitality. The shield others stand behind.
evaluation.beyondsolo.class.healer: Deep mana and resilience. Keeps the party alive.
evaluation.beyondsolo.class.ranger: Keen senses and swift feet. Nothing escapes notice.
notify.beyondsolo.welcome.title: Welcome, Player.
notify.beyondsolo.welcome.body: The System is bound to you. Find a village and touch its Evaluation Crystal to learn your rank and class.
notify.beyondsolo.scan_interrupted.title: Evaluation interrupted
notify.beyondsolo.scan_interrupted.body: You moved too far from the crystal.
notify.beyondsolo.evaluated.title: Evaluation complete
notify.beyondsolo.system_online.title: The System is now active
notify.beyondsolo.system_online.body: Press [%s] to open your Status window. Press [%s] to hide or bring back these messages.
notify.beyondsolo.already_evaluated.lock: Rank: %s    Class: %s    Next re-evaluation at level %s
notify.beyondsolo.reeval_ready.title: Re-evaluation available
notify.beyondsolo.reeval_ready.body: Level %s milestone reached. Touch an Evaluation Crystal to have your rank measured again.
notify.beyondsolo.threshold.title: Something has changed
notify.beyondsolo.threshold.body: Your mana stirs in a way it did not before. The crystal may read you differently now. Next re-evaluation at level %s.
notify.beyondsolo.threshold.body.ready: Your mana stirs in a way it did not before. The crystal may read you differently now.
notify.beyondsolo.reevaluated.up.title: Rank up!
notify.beyondsolo.reevaluated.same.title: Re-evaluation complete
notify.beyondsolo.reevaluated.same.body: Rank confirmed: %s-Rank. Next re-evaluation at level %s.
notify.beyondsolo.rebirth.title: Elixir of Rebirth
notify.beyondsolo.rebirth.body: %s stat points returned. Spend them again in the STATUS tab.
notify.beyondsolo.rebirth.none: You have no spent stat points to take back.
evaluation.beyondsolo.reeval.promoted: Promoted from %s-Rank. Your growth has been recognised.
evaluation.beyondsolo.reeval.unchanged: No new rank detected. Keep growing.
evaluation.beyondsolo.reeval.class: Your path is unchanged. The System confirms it.
status.beyondsolo.reeval.ready.desc: You reached a new milestone. Touch an Evaluation Crystal to have your rank measured again. It can only go up.
status.beyondsolo.reeval.locked.desc: The crystal reads you once per milestone. Next re-evaluation at level %s.
notify.beyondsolo.level_up.title: Level Up!
notify.beyondsolo.level_up.body: You reached level %s. Unspent stat points: %s
notify.beyondsolo.exhaustion_warning.bod: Rest now, or your body will give out.
notify.beyondsolo.collapse.title: You collapsed
notify.beyondsolo.collapse.body: Your body has reached its limit. You can't move for %s seconds.
notify.beyondsolo.recovered.title: Recovered
item.beyondsolo.quenching_elixir.desc: Puts out a Deep Burn, the only thing that can. Wards against fire for a minute.
item.beyondsolo.antidote.desc: Cures Venom and poison. Too weak for Heavy Venom.
item.beyondsolo.greater_antidote.desc: Cures any venom, Heavy Venom included, and wards against poison.
item.beyondsolo.clotting_tonic.desc: Stops bleeding, lifts a Crimson Brand and wards against blood loss.
tooltip.beyondsolo.armor_weight: Heavy armor: sprinting is more tiring
set.beyondsolo.hunter.bonus: 4 pieces: 20% less exhaustion, a little faster
set.beyondsolo.knight.bonus: 4 pieces: +20% blood resistance, stands firm against knockback
set.beyondsolo.dusk.bonus: 4 pieces: +15% fire, poison and crimson resistance
quest_fail.beyondsolo.day_ended: The day ended before it was done.
quest.beyondsolo.proof_of_strength.desc: The System wants to see what you can do. Defeat the creatures that roam the dark.
quest.beyondsolo.provisions.desc: No hunter survives on luck alone. Gather iron and wood for the road ahead.
quest.beyondsolo.growth.desc: Strength is earned, not given. Grow stronger and cover ground.
quest.beyondsolo.trial_of_depths.desc: Find a gate and go through it. Clear the dungeon on the other side, and cut down whatever crosses your path.
quest.beyondsolo.daily.desc: Run, jump, squat and strike, every day without fail. Finishing restores your body in full. Training left unfinished at dawn, or given up, is punished in the Penalty Zone.
quest.beyondsolo.spawner_nest.desc: A nest of monsters has been detected. Destroy its spawn and the source before it spreads. Do not leave the area.
quest.beyondsolo.ambush.desc: You are surrounded. Survive and fight back.
quest.beyondsolo.deep_veins.desc: The rock here is thick with ore. Mine it while you can.
quest.beyondsolo.offer.title: New quest: %s
quest.beyondsolo.reward.title: Title: %s
quest.beyondsolo.penalty: Penalty: +%s%% fatigue, weakness and slowness for %ss
command.beyondsolo.quest.none: Nothing to do: no matching quest.
item.beyondsolo.sealed_parcel.hint: Use it at the marked spot to deliver it
npc.beyondsolo.empty: %s has nothing more to ask of you today. New requests come at dawn.
npc.beyondsolo.shunned: %s doesn't trust you after the last request. Come back tomorrow.
npc.beyondsolo.full: You already hold %s requests. Finish one first.
npc.beyondsolo.nest.title: The nest stirs
npc.beyondsolo.nest.body: Monsters crawl out around the marked spot.
npc.beyondsolo.giver_gone.title: %s is gone
npc.beyondsolo.giver_gone.body: No one to report back to. "%s" will complete on its own.
npc.beyondsolo.parcel.void: This parcel's delivery fell through. It crumbles in your hands.
npc.beyondsolo.parcel.not_here: Not here. The marked spot is %s blocks %s.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.gather.0.desc: %s is running short. Bring what is needed and hand it over.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.gather.1.desc: %s wants to be ready before the next hard night. Gather the goods and bring them back.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.gather.2.desc: Work has stopped at %s's bench. Fetch the materials and return.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.hunt.0.desc: %s wants the %s problem near the village dealt with. Defeat them, then report back.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.hunt.1.desc: %2$s sightings keep %1$s up at night. Hunt them down and report back.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.hunt.2.desc: %s posted a bounty on every %s in the area. Collect it once they are dealt with.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.clear.0.desc: %s saw monsters gathering %s blocks %s of here. Clear the nest, then report back.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.clear.1.desc: Something has made a lair %2$s blocks %3$s of the village. %1$s wants it gone.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.clear.2.desc: %s marked a nest %s blocks %s of here. Wipe it out and come back.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.escort.0.desc: %s must reach a spot %s blocks %s of here. Keep them alive on the way.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.escort.1.desc: %s is afraid of the road. Walk with them %s blocks %s and see them there safely.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.escort.2.desc: Guard %s on the road %s blocks %s. If they fall, the request fails.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.deliver.0.desc: %s hands you a sealed parcel. Carry it %s blocks %s and use it at the marked spot.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.deliver.1.desc: %s needs a parcel taken %s blocks %s, and fast. Use it when you get there.
quest.beyondsolo.npc.deliver.2.desc: %s's letter must reach the place %s blocks %s of here. Use the parcel there.
quest_fail.beyondsolo.lost: The one you protected was lost.
quest.beyondsolo.ready.title: Ready to hand in: %s
notify.beyondsolo.gate.detected.title: A %s-Rank Gate Has Been Detected
notify.beyondsolo.gate.detected.body: A rift to the %s. Danger: %s. Step into it to enter.
notify.beyondsolo.gate.danger.title: Warning
notify.beyondsolo.gate.danger.body: This %s-Rank Gate is far above your rank. Survival is not expected.
notify.beyondsolo.gate.opened.title: A %s-Rank Gate Has Opened
notify.beyondsolo.gate.opened.body: Something tore through the world about %s blocks from you.
notify.beyondsolo.gate.exit.title: The Gate Is Closing
notify.beyondsolo.gate.exit.body: An exit has opened in the boss's arena. Leave before the gate closes.
notify.beyondsolo.gate.cache.title: Rewards
message.beyondsolo.gate.unevaluated: The gate rejects you. The System cannot read you yet.
quest.beyondsolo.gate_clear.desc: You have entered the %s. Cut through its monsters and defeat %s, the gate's master.
command.beyondsolo.gate.not_inside: You are not inside a gate.
command.beyondsolo.gate.unknown: There is no realm or layout called %s.
command.beyondsolo.gate.info: %s (%s) · %s · Rank %s · %s rooms, %s passages, %s open spaces · boss: %s · element: %s · seed %s
command.beyondsolo.gate.info_legacy: An old cave: it keeps the look and layout it was built with.
item.beyondsolo.skill_tome.unread.tip: Read it to learn a skill your class doesn't know yet.
skills.beyondsolo.tome.unreadable: The writing means nothing to you yet. The System has not awakened.
skills.beyondsolo.tome.nothing: There is nothing left in this tome for you to learn.
skills.beyondsolo.tome.wrong_class: Your class can't make sense of this skill.
skills.beyondsolo.tome.mastered: You have already mastered this skill.
skills.beyondsolo.acquired.equip: Equip it in the System window
skills.beyondsolo.acquired.passive: Always active. See it in the System window
skills.beyondsolo.refused.blocked: You can't use skills right now
skills.beyondsolo.bar.hint: Click a slot to assign. Right click clears.
skills.beyondsolo.bar.hint_none: Pick a learned active skill to equip it.
skills.beyondsolo.locked.or_tome: or sooner from a Skill Tome
skill.beyondsolo.surge_step.flavour: Mana floods your legs and the world blurs past.
skill.beyondsolo.surge_step.desc: Dash %s blocks the way you are facing. Breaks falls and shrugs off a hit for a moment.
skill.beyondsolo.pulse_scan.flavour: A ring of mana rolls out and everything hostile lights up.
skill.beyondsolo.pulse_scan.desc: Reveals every hostile creature within %s blocks through walls for %s seconds.
skill.beyondsolo.appraising_gaze.flavour: Look closer. Every creature has a seam.
skill.beyondsolo.appraising_gaze.desc: For %s seconds, see each creature's level, health and elemental weakness, with its weak spot marked. Your hits deal %s%% more.
skill.beyondsolo.phantom_shroud.flavour: Your outline frays into smoke and the monsters lose you.
skill.beyondsolo.phantom_shroud.desc: Hide from monsters for %s seconds. Anything chasing you loses track. Attacking ends it.
skill.beyondsolo.unbroken_will.flavour: The body tires. The will doesn't.
skill.beyondsolo.mana_flow.flavour: Mana runs through you like a second pulse.
skill.beyondsolo.rending_arc.flavour: One swing that cuts the air itself.
skill.beyondsolo.rending_arc.desc: Two crescent slashes in front of you, there and back: %s damage (+STR) in all to everything in the arc, knocking it back.
skill.beyondsolo.war_cry.flavour: A roar that steadies allies and shakes monsters.
skill.beyondsolo.war_cry.desc: You and nearby allies gain Strength %s for %s seconds. Nearby monsters are weakened and slowed.
skill.beyondsolo.earthsplitter.flavour: Leap, then bring the ground down with you.
skill.beyondsolo.earthsplitter.desc: Leap up and slam down: %s damage (+STR) in a wide ring, throwing monsters into the air.
skill.beyondsolo.shadowstep.flavour: There one moment, behind them the next.
skill.beyondsolo.shadowstep.desc: Blink behind the creature you look at (or ahead). Your next strike within 3 seconds deals %s%% more and crits.
skill.beyondsolo.venom_edge.flavour: Coat the blade. Let it work.
skill.beyondsolo.venom_edge.desc: For %s seconds, your strikes add %s venom buildup.
skill.beyondsolo.keen_instinct.flavour: You move before you decide to.
skill.beyondsolo.veil_of_night.desc: Vanish for %s seconds. Monsters lose you, and your first strike from the dark deals %s%% more.
skill.beyondsolo.arc_bolt.flavour: A thread of lightning, pulled straight from your mana.
skill.beyondsolo.arc_bolt.desc: Hurl a bolt at the creature you look at: %s damage (+INT).
skill.beyondsolo.ember_burst.flavour: Heat gathers in your chest and bursts out.
skill.beyondsolo.ember_burst.desc: A ring of fire around you: %s damage (+INT) and %s burn buildup, pushing monsters back.
skill.beyondsolo.starfall.flavour: Call down burning stars on the place you point to.
skill.beyondsolo.starfall.desc: %s meteors fall where you look, %s damage (+INT) each, with burn buildup.
skill.beyondsolo.bulwark.flavour: Raise a wall of mana around yourself.
skill.beyondsolo.bulwark.desc: Gain a %s point shield and Resistance for 6 seconds.
skill.beyondsolo.provoke.desc: Every monster within %s blocks turns on you and is slowed. You gain Resistance.
skill.beyondsolo.stoneskin.flavour: Blows land on you like rain on rock.
skill.beyondsolo.aegis_dome.flavour: A dome of light that nothing hostile can stand inside.
skill.beyondsolo.aegis_dome.desc: For %s seconds, allies inside the dome gain Resistance II and Regeneration. Monsters are pushed out.
skill.beyondsolo.mending_light.desc: Heal yourself and allies within 7 blocks for %s health.
skill.beyondsolo.purify.flavour: Wash away what clings to you.
skill.beyondsolo.purify.desc: Cleanse you and nearby allies of venom, the crimson brand, buildups and most harmful effects. Heavy venom and deep burns still need their remedies.
skill.beyondsolo.life_bloom.flavour: Life keeps growing back in you.
skill.beyondsolo.sanctuary.flavour: Holy ground: healing for friends, pain for foes.
skill.beyondsolo.sanctuary.desc: For 8 seconds, allies in the circle heal %s per second, and monsters in it are hurt and slowed.
skill.beyondsolo.piercing_shot.flavour: An arrow of mana that does not stop.
skill.beyondsolo.piercing_shot.desc: Fire a shot that pierces everything in a line for %s damage (+AGI).
skill.beyondsolo.hunters_mark.flavour: Pick your prey. Everyone else will too.
skill.beyondsolo.hunters_mark.desc: Mark the creature you look at for 12 seconds. It glows and takes %s%% more damage from everyone.
skill.beyondsolo.arrow_rain.desc: %s arrows rain down where you look.
skill.beyondsolo.bull_rush.flavour: Nothing in your way stays there.
skill.beyondsolo.bull_rush.desc: Charge %s blocks ahead. Everything you run into takes %s damage (+STR) and is thrown aside.
skill.beyondsolo.flame_wave.flavour: The blade drags fire out of the ground.
skill.beyondsolo.flame_wave.desc: A wall of fire rolls 9 blocks ahead: %s fire damage (+STR) and %s burn buildup to everything in its path.
skill.beyondsolo.bloodlust.flavour: Every kill feeds the next one.
skill.beyondsolo.bloodlust.desc: Each kill restores %s health and %s mana.
skill.beyondsolo.whirlwind.flavour: Stand in the middle of it and nothing touches you.
skill.beyondsolo.whirlwind.desc: Spin for a second: four cuts of %s damage (+STR) all around you, each drawing foes in. You take less damage while spinning.
skill.beyondsolo.fan_of_blades.desc: Throw blades in a wide fan: %s damage (+AGI) to everything within 9 blocks in front of you.
skill.beyondsolo.shadow_bind.flavour: Its own shadow will not let it go.
skill.beyondsolo.shadow_bind.desc: Pin the creature you look at to its shadow for %s seconds: it cannot move or fight back, and takes %s damage (+AGI).
skill.beyondsolo.cruel_precision.flavour: The back is where the mercy ends.
skill.beyondsolo.cruel_precision.desc: Melee hits from behind deal %s%% more damage.
skill.beyondsolo.death_blossom.desc: Spin and throw poisoned petals 5 blocks around you: %s damage (+AGI) and %s venom buildup.
skill.beyondsolo.tidal_orb.desc: Hurl a ball of water that bursts where it lands: %s damage (+INT) within 3 blocks, soaking and slowing. Puts out fires.
skill.beyondsolo.chain_lightning.desc: Lightning strikes the creature you look at for %s damage (+INT), then jumps to up to %s more nearby, a little weaker each time.
skill.beyondsolo.elemental_attunement.fl: You feel where two forces want to meet.
skill.beyondsolo.elemental_attunement.de: Element reactions you set off are %s%% stronger.
skill.beyondsolo.cyclone.flavour: The wind picks a spot and stays.
skill.beyondsolo.cyclone.desc: Raise a whirlwind where you look for 4 seconds. It drags creatures in and cuts them for %s damage (+INT) twice a second.
skill.beyondsolo.shield_bash.desc: Slam into the creature in front of you: %s damage (+VIT), thrown back and stunned for %s seconds.
skill.beyondsolo.stone_spikes.desc: Spikes of rock erupt 8 blocks ahead: %s damage (+VIT), throwing creatures into the air and slowing them.
skill.beyondsolo.thorned_guard.flavour: Strike the wall and bleed for it.
skill.beyondsolo.thorned_guard.desc: Creatures that hit you in melee take %s damage.
skill.beyondsolo.sunlance.flavour: The sky answers, a moment late.
skill.beyondsolo.sunlance.desc: Call a lance of sunlight onto the spot you look at. A moment later it lands: %s damage (+VIT) within 3 blocks, more to the undead, and it mends allies standing in it.
skill.beyondsolo.radiant_lance.desc: A beam of light through everything in its path, 24 blocks: %s damage (+INT), half again to the undead.
skill.beyondsolo.tidewell.flavour: The water remembers how you were made.
skill.beyondsolo.tidewell.desc: A wave of healing water 7 blocks around you: allies are mended and regenerate for %s seconds; foes take %s damage and are soaked and slowed.
skill.beyondsolo.thornbind.desc: Brambles grow where you look for 5 seconds. Creatures inside can barely move, take %s damage a second and are poisoned.
skill.beyondsolo.ember_arrow.flavour: It lands as a campfire. Briefly.
skill.beyondsolo.ember_arrow.desc: An arrow that bursts into flame where it lands: %s fire damage (+AGI) within 3 blocks and %s burn buildup.
skill.beyondsolo.vault_shot.flavour: Never let them close the distance.
skill.beyondsolo.vault_shot.desc: Loose a spread at close range for %s damage (+AGI), slowing what it hits, and leap backwards.
skill.beyondsolo.steady_aim.flavour: Distance is just more time to aim.
skill.beyondsolo.steady_aim.desc: Skill hits from more than %s blocks away deal %s%% more damage.
skill.beyondsolo.thunder_volley.flavour: The arrows only show the storm where to go.
skill.beyondsolo.thunder_volley.desc: Call %s lightning strikes onto creatures around the spot you look at: %s damage (+AGI) each.
item.beyondsolo.sunderveil.lore: The Arbiter's own verdict, cut down to a size a mortal can lift.
item.beyondsolo.ashen_oath.lore: It still burns with the promise that was broken to forge it.
item.beyondsolo.nightglass_fang.lore: A sliver of the dark between gates. It is never quite where you look.
item.beyondsolo.thorn_requiem.lore: Every life it takes grows another thorn along the blade.
message.beyondsolo.gate.sealed_other: This gate is waiting for someone else.
message.beyondsolo.gate.held_back: The way out will not take you. Something deeper is waiting.
message.beyondsolo.crystal_silent: The crystal stays dark. Nothing in you answers it yet.
message.beyondsolo.presystem.hint: You feel ordinary. They say the gates change people who survive them.
command.beyondsolo.trial.not_now: That does not apply right now.
title.beyondsolo.arbiter_slayer: The One Who Was Not Judged
awakening.beyondsolo.called.title: SOMETHING HAS NOTICED YOU
awakening.beyondsolo.called.body: A sealed gate has opened. It will not let you walk away.
awakening.beyondsolo.tether.title: THE GATE PULLS YOU BACK
awakening.beyondsolo.threshold.title: ASHEN THRESHOLD
awakening.beyondsolo.threshold.body: The way behind you is gone. Go down.
awakening.beyondsolo.revive.title: NOT YET
awakening.beyondsolo.revive.body: You are not allowed to end here.
awakening.beyondsolo.slain.title: IMPOSSIBLE
awakening.beyondsolo.slain.hint: Something was left behind for you.
awakening.beyondsolo.dark.2: You were found wanting... and you came anyway.
awakening.beyondsolo.window.found: A suitable host has been found.
awakening.beyondsolo.window.cond_fallen: Stood before the Arbiter and did not turn back
awakening.beyondsolo.awakened.title: THE SYSTEM HAS AWAKENED
awakening.beyondsolo.awakened.body_slain: Welcome, %s. You begin where others can never reach.
item.beyondsolo.lycan_fang_knife.lore: A fang pried from a steel-furred wolf in an E-rank gate. It still wants to bite.
item.beyondsolo.goblin_shiv.lore: Crude, notched and smeared with something green. Goblins never wash their blades.
item.beyondsolo.apprentice_staff.lore: Issued to every new mage at the Association. The orb hums when mana is near.
item.beyondsolo.acolyte_mace.lore: A healer's first weapon: heavy enough to end a fight, blessed enough to mend after it.
item.beyondsolo.ironclad_warhammer.lore: Plain iron, honest weight. Tanks swear by it for their first raids.
item.beyondsolo.hunters_shortbow.lore: Light, quick and forgiving. Every ranger starts somewhere.
item.beyondsolo.knightsbane.lore: A black blade forged to slip between plates. The heavier the armor, the deeper it goes.
item.beyondsolo.frostwarden_dagger.lore: Taken from the queen of a frozen gate's elves. Frost creeps up whatever it cuts.
item.beyondsolo.warchief_cleaver.lore: The high orc chieftain swung it one-handed. Mere humans need both.
item.beyondsolo.silvermoon_rapier.lore: A duelist's needle that drinks a little of every wound it opens.
item.beyondsolo.naga_glaive.lore: Carved from the fang of a swamp serpent-queen. The venom never quite dried.
item.beyondsolo.winter_breath_staff.lore: The crystal at its tip never melts, even in a fire gate.
item.beyondsolo.windrunner_longbow.lore: Strung with wind-spider silk. Arrows from it barely seem to fall.
item.beyondsolo.mending_scepter.lore: Every blow it lands sends a little light back to those who stand with you.
item.beyondsolo.thunderfang_longsword.lo: Its fuller is a captured bolt. Strike hard enough and the storm jumps free.
The sword of a knight who served a throne of shadow. Red light still runs along its edge.
item.beyondsolo.swarm_king_talons.lore: The claws of an insect king that ate its way through an island. They finish what they start.
item.beyondsolo.frostbear_gauntlets.lore: Fur and claws of a giant ice bear. Punches leave frost behind.
item.beyondsolo.dawnpetal_rapier.lore: Light as a falling petal. Its dance builds, step by step, to one perfect cut.
item.beyondsolo.ember_sage_staff.lore: A sage of the fire gates poured his last flame into it.
item.beyondsolo.lifebloom_staff.lore: A sapling that never stopped growing. Its flower opens wider the more it heals.
item.beyondsolo.serpentsting_bow.lore: Its limbs are two coiled snakes. Every arrow it looses carries their venom.
item.beyondsolo.stormlord_longsword.lore: Once carried by the lord of a tower of demons. Lightning answers its every swing.
item.beyondsolo.titans_knuckles.lore: Made for a giant of a man who held the line alone. Blows bounce off whoever wears them.
item.beyondsolo.hellhound_halberd.lore: The three-headed guardian of a demon tower fell. Its fire stayed in the steel.
item.beyondsolo.starseer_staff.lore: It shows its bearer where the stars will fall, and lets them choose.
item.beyondsolo.saints_sunstaff.lore: Carried by a healer who walked out of an S-rank gate with every one of her party alive.
item.beyondsolo.galebreaker_warbow.lore: Draw it fully and the wind itself nocks two more arrows beside yours.
item.beyondsolo.nightveil_kris.lore: A shadow-forged kris. It strikes deepest at the backs of those who never saw it coming.
item.beyondsolo.ironblood_claymore.lore: Runes of blood run down its spine. The more it takes, the more its wielder keeps.
item.beyondsolo.hellsovereign_fang.lore: One of a pair, forged in a sovereign's hellfire. Two in hand burn twice as bright.
item.beyondsolo.winterborne_requiem.lore: A lance of eternal ice from a frozen sovereign's court. Its song is the silence after a blizzard.
item.beyondsolo.stormcaller_edict.lore: Its verdict is lightning, and there is no appeal.
item.beyondsolo.ruinbringer.lore: A greatsword from the age of the first sovereigns. It does not cut so much as end things.
item.beyondsolo.calamity_fang.lore: Carved from the fang of the dragon that was calamity itself. It remembers how to burn a city.
item.beyondsolo.eye_of_the_insatiable.lo: A sovereign's eye that never stopped hungering. It feeds its mage everything it devours.
item.beyondsolo.colossus_aegis.lore: Broken from the hand of the stone colossus that guarded the first gate. Nothing moves it.
item.beyondsolo.world_tree_branch.lore: Every healer has heard the story. Few believe the branch is real.
item.beyondsolo.starfall_longbow.lore: Its string was spun from a falling star. Loose it fully and the sky follows the arrow down.
trait.beyondsolo.frostbite: Frostbite: hits stack a chill; the 4th freezes for %s s
trait.beyondsolo.thunderclap: Thunderclap: %s chance to arc lightning into 3 more foes
trait.beyondsolo.armor_breaker: Armor Breaker: +%s damage per point of the target's armor
trait.beyondsolo.lifesteal: Lifesteal: heals %s of the damage dealt
trait.beyondsolo.executioner: Executioner: +%s damage to targets under 35%% health
trait.beyondsolo.mending: Mending: hits heal you and nearby allies for %s of the damage
trait.beyondsolo.rhythm: Rhythm: every 4th hit in a row deals %s damage
trait.beyondsolo.bulwark: Bulwark: take %s less damage while held
trait.beyondsolo.twin: Twin: +%s damage with a twin weapon in the other hand
trait.beyondsolo.split_shot: Split Shot: full draws loose %s extra arrows
signature.beyondsolo.infernal_rend.desc: For 6 s every strike adds hellfire and heavy burn buildup.
signature.beyondsolo.absolute_zero.desc: Freezes every foe within 7 blocks solid for 4 s.
signature.beyondsolo.heavens_verdict.des: Calls lightning down on up to 5 foes within 10 blocks.
signature.beyondsolo.cataclysm_cleave.de: A burning cleave that tears through everything in a wide arc ahead.
signature.beyondsolo.dragons_wrath.desc: Dash up to 9 blocks through your foes, branding them crimson.
signature.beyondsolo.devouring_star.desc: A star that bursts where you look, scaled by spell power.
signature.beyondsolo.colossus_stance.des: Draw every foe's eye, throw back those close, and shrug off blows for 8 s.
signature.beyondsolo.verdant_blessing.de: Heals your party for 40% of their health and washes away most ailments.
signature.beyondsolo.starfall.desc: Fully drawn arrows bring a bolt of starlight down on what they hit.
tooltip.beyondsolo.bound.refused: It refuses you: half damage, no signature
message.beyondsolo.weapon_refuses: The weapon refuses you. Only a %s can wake it.
set.beyondsolo.dusk.two: 2 pieces: +8% fire, poison and crimson resistance
